Grove Tirnenn are tirnenn located in Root-Home in Ardenweald.
Grounding Breath is a conduit for monks. It drops from Ingra Maloch in the Mists of Tirna Scithe, Lady Inerva Darkvein in Castle Nathria, and Soulrender Dormazain in the Sanctum of Domination.

Grounding Surge is a conduit for mages. It drops from Timecap'n Hooktail in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market, Lady Inerva Darkvein in Castle Nathria, and Rygelon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones. It is also sold by Zo'sorg in Oribos for .
Grove Watchers are ravens located around Teller Farm in Drustvar.
Gruesh is a devilsaur located in Torga's Rest in Nazmir. It is being under attack from Loa-Gutter Skullcrushers and Loa-Gutter Darters.
Gruesh's Brood are dead devilsaurs located in Nazmir. Their blood is being drained by Nazwathan skeletons.
The Grungy Containment Pack drops from Bubbleblood in the Forgotten Wounds in Maldraxxus.
Gruesome Torturers are orcs located in The Pit in Gorgrond. They are torturing Captured Rangari.

The Grove of Terror is where souls are prepared for the Penitent Hunt, a tradition of the Forest Ward. It is also where the Night Market is located in the south of the area. The Muck Pool: Banewood is to the east, Wanecrypt Hill to the north, and Dredhollow to the west.
__NOTOC__ Grubby is a quest reward from A New Age, part of the Kyrian Campaign.
Gruffhorns are a category of tamable beasts made up of goats and rams.
Grove Tender's Spade were sold by general supplies vendors in Ardenweald in lieu of Herbalist's Spade.
Grove Hippogryph is a hippogryph located in the Twilight Grove in Duskwood during A Foe of the Dark.

The Grove of Memory is an area of the dream tree of Tirna Rowen, located on a plateau above the Shrouded Mire. It serves as the night fae archive of curses and hexes, including spriggan curses, maintain by Archivist Dreyden. It is currently being invaded by Rotbriar spriggans.

The Growthworks is an area of the dream tree of Tirna Eas under the Droman the Lady of the Falls where the artisans that make all the night fae weapons and armor are usually located, but due to the spriggan infestation on orders of Mueh'zala, they were forced to relocate to Glitterfall Basin.
Gruukuuek the Elder is a tirnenn located in the Maw as a boss of a Tormentors of Torghast event.
Grove Defenders are vorkai located throughout Ardenweald. They were present during The Battle of Ardenweald.
Grubby Servant-Grabbers drop from Raal the Gluttonous in Waycrest Manor.
The Gruesome Flayedwing teaches how to summon a flayedwing mount.
__NOTOC__ Ground Nightshade are created with Shadowlands Alchemy (75); taught by Elixirist Au'pyr.
Grubby Dirtcrunchers are dredgers located in Sanguine Depths.
The Grovetender's Pack is granted at 15 Renown (Shadowlands) with the Night Fae Covenant.
The Grunge-Caked Collarbone drops from Boneslurp in Maldraxxus.
Grove Warden's Edge is looted from Hunt-Captain Korayn's Extravagant Tribute. It is sold by Phixin in Bastion for .
Grotesque Mutilator's Leggings drop from Vuk'laz the Earthbreaker in Uldum.
Grovetender's Cummerbund drops from Basten in the Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.
Grotesque Goring Pick drops from Corpsecutter Moroc in Maldraxxus.

Grummle Convoy is a group of grummles traveling with yaks from One Keg through the Burlap Trail to Kota Basecamp during The Burlap Trail: To Burlap Waystation and The Burlap Trail: To Kota Basecamp. It consists of a Grummle Trail Guide, three Trail Packers, and a Trail Yakker who pulls three Clean Yaks. Once the quests are finished, the map marker disappears, but the NPCs continue to appear.
Groundrumble Boots drops from Rom'ogg Bonecrusher in Blackrock Caverns.
Grrgl's Spotted Shell is a transmog appearance for the back slot, unlocked by purchasing or receiving the Baby Murloc Satch-Shells ensemble.
Grove Hunters are vorkai located in Desmotaeron in the Maw and in Provis Terra in Zereth Mortis.
Groundskeeper Kama is a green dragonspawn found in the Emerald Enclave in Valdrakken. Several Shaggy Dreamhares are running around nearby.

__NOTOC__ Growlbossify is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by freeing Chief Softpaw, equiping her with weapons, and making sure she survives Hackclaw's War-Band in Brackenhide Hollow on Mythic Difficulty.
Grungle is a Tuskarr Feast Reagent that is used near a Tuskarr Feast.
Gryffin is a gryphon located in the Obsidian Enclave in Valdrakken. During Secrets of Azeroth, he can be given a Fresh Tyranha in exchange for a Downy Helmet Liner.
Grove Protection is a Guardian druid PvP talent, available at level 55.
__NOTOC__ Grungir Ironspout is a dwarf located in the Azure Span.

Gruff Hunters are tuskarr located in Grimtusk's Hideaway in the Azure Span.
Grugoth the Hullcrusher is a rare elite ettin spawning in a small cove on the Broken Seaboard of the southern shore of Forbidden Reach.
__NOTOC__ Grounded Primalists are furbolgs located in the Flashfrost Assault in the Waking Shores.
Grubby Deckhands are humans located on a ship in the Southern Savage Coast in the Cape of Stranglethorn. Some of them are repairing the deck, others are cheering at Seaspray Blasters.
Grotto Netherwing Drake is a dragonriding mount that is the July 2023 completion award for filling out the Traveler's Log at the Trading Post.
Grunt's Eternal Treads drops from Time-Lost Battlefield in Dawn of the Infinite.
Grove Guardians is a Restoration druid talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Nourish.
Grounded Stone Focus is a quest reward from Know Thy Enemy (quest).
Ground Gorgrond Pepper is sold by Far'kul Flametongue in Crystallic Socket for .
Grunt's Buckler is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 50 Trader's Tender.

Grunt Ounda guards The Iron Eagle from Alliance members from coming aboard the zeppelin that runs between Orgrimmar and Grom'gol Base Camp. If asked, she will simply say that they, meaning Umgor and herself, protect the airship.
Grunt Umgor guards The Iron Eagle from Alliance members from coming aboard the zeppelin that runs between Orgrimmar and Grom'gol Base Camp. He has nothing to say, unlike Ounda.

Guard Troy was a footman of Garithos' Enforcers who was stationed in the dungeons of Dalaran along Guard Seth to guard prisoners. He released flesh golems upon Kael'thas Sunstrider and Lady Vashj as they were making their escape. Troy was killed during the break-out.

Guard Seth was a footman of Garithos' Enforcers who was stationed in the dungeons of Dalaran along Guard Troy to guard prisoners. Guard Troy released flesh golems upon Kael'thas Sunstrider and Lady Vashj as they were making their escape. Seth was killed during the break-out.

Guard Marcus was a footman of Garithos' Enforcers who was stationed in the dungeons of Dalaran along Guard Trogdar to guard prisoners. He guarded Kael'thas Sunstrider's prison and taunted him until Lady Vashj freed him. Marcus was killed in the process.

Guard Trogdar was a footman of Garithos' Enforcers who was stationed in the dungeons of Dalaran along Guard Marcus to guard prisoners. He guarded Kael'thas Sunstrider's prison until Lady Vashj freed him. He stated blood elves gave him the creeps. Trogdar was killed in the process.

Guardian's Favor reduces the cooldown of your Hand of Protection and increases the duration of your Hand of Freedom. You will need to spend 7 points in Retribution to max it.

Gryphon Master Talonaxe is a dwarf quest giver located at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands. His father worked with the Explorers' League excavation that discovered Uldaman. Since Falstad Wildhammer left for Ironforge, Talonaxe took over the coordination and defense of Aerie Peak. Talonaxe sent Gilda Cloudcaller to Quel'Danil Lodge to deal with Shadra. After the spider god was summoned, he led a group of dwarves to fight her. During the Fourth War, he was stationed at the gryphon roost in Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills. When Horde champions were sent to infiltrate the roost and kill the Wildhammer clan gryphons, they encountered Talonaxe.
__NOTOC__ Guardian Gloves are created with Leatherworking (190); taught by trainers.

Guardian pets are one of three types of pets that can be summoned/created. * They will enter into combat on their summoner's behalf, much as a combat pet will, but cannot be directly controlled. They react as a combat pet set on Aggressive and Follow. * They are generally summoned on a temporary basis, unlike combat pets or Small Pets. Most guardian pets "share a cooldown" with other guardian pets of 1 minute. Most non-consumable items (of all varieties) that generate guardian pets have a longer cooldown period than 1 minute. For these items, it is more descriptive to say that they force a global "guardian pet item" cooldown of 1 minute. This means that while you may not summon a second guar

The Guardian Talisman is a trinket that gives a chance of increasing the wearer's armor when hit in combat. If you've done the quest chain once, and have a basic understanding of the chain, this can be one of the earliest trinkets a non-engineer character can obtain.

Guard Thomas is a human quest giver located by the bridge west of Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. He is a member of the Stormwind Army.
Gryphonwing Long Bow is a bow. The + agility and stamina make it an excellent ranged weapon for a hunter, rogue or warrior.
Guard Byron is a human quest giver located on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. During the Attack on Theramore Isle, he remained in town. As such, he very likely died during the mana-bombing.

.]] Gryphon riders (also spelled gryphonrider and gryphon-riders) are windriders who serve as air support in the armies of the Alliance's nations. Most of them are dwarves of the Wildhammer clan, known to wield deadly stormhammers and to have a special bond with their gryphon mounts, but recently Ironforge dwarves and humans alike have started deploying gryphon riders of their own. A group of gryphon riders is called a gryphon wing. They are often under the guidance of a wing commander, which is sometimes stationed on the ground near their target area. Gryphon riders typically need an harness to properly control their mount. A saddle is preferred though optional, as some dwarves are known to

Gryshka's Letter is Innkeeper Gryshka's letter to Grimtak. In it, she writes her thanks to Grimtak for the well-prepared meat he had delivered. She recounts the time Grimtak lost a finger in an accident, and thinks humorous of the entire situation. She concludes that he is cute when he's bleeding.
Guard Didier is a dwarf quest giver found in the Eastern Plaguelands.

The Guest Chambers in Karazhan are a series of large bedrooms lining the hallway beyond the Grand Ballroom. This is also the area where Kayanna's Log can be found, and where the Maiden of Virtue presides, in the circular room at the end of the hall.

Guardian of Icecrowns are crypt lords summoned during Phase 3 of the Kel'Thuzad encounter in Naxxramas. On normal (10-man) difficulty, when Kel'Thuzad shouts "Master! I require aid!", two Guardians come through the portals within Kel'Thuzad's Chamber. On heroic (25-man), there are four Guardians. The Guardians have a self-buff known as Blood Tap, which increases their damage by 15% and their size by 10% and can stack up to 99 times. When Kel'Thuzad is defeated, the Guardians will flee. The Guardians are immune to all CC (including Shackles) in both normal and heroic Naxxramas. Starting with Arena Season 4, the Brutal Gladiator 5-piece armor set is available for Arena Points. This covers head, shoulders, chest, hands and legs. Wrist, waist, feet, neck and finger PvP equipment matching the Season 4 Set is available for Honor points and Marks of Honor. They share the name "Guardian's" and replace the "Vindicator's" equipment of Arena Season 3. The Guardian items are remarkable as they are epics with item level 154 and 159. Items of this level are otherwise found in Sunwell Plateau. They will also require a personal and team rating to acquire.

Gryphon Commander Urik is a human quest giver located in Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight.
Guardian's Shadow Crystal is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.
Guardian of Cenarius is a reputation achievement earned by becoming with the Cenarion Circle and the Cenarion Expedition. The title is formatted like this: :, Guardian of Cenarius

The Guardhouse is a room found behind a previously locked door in Karazhan and which only became accessible to players during the Scourge Invasion world event preceding World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King. During the event there were several containers, within the chamber, filled with what appeared to be blood. In the center of the room was Prince Tenris Mirkblood and the quest item Orders from the Lich King. However, with Mirkblood slain, the room has been cleansed of his presence and all containers removed. The only thing in the room now is a few tables and chairs.
Guardian's Dreadstone is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.

A Guardian's Moldy Card is a pledge gift given out by (guard) NPCs during the Love is in the Air seasonal event. These are combined into packages which are in turn hierarchically combined with other pledge packages for buffs and rewards. All of the Love is in the Air pledge gifts are non-functional as regards their name and picture. You cannot read a Guardian's Moldy Card. __NOTOC__

Guardian of Time is a bronze dragonspawn found in Market Row in Old Stratholme (heroic mode only). When the timed event starts you will have 25 minutes to save him before he's fully corrupted by the Infinite Corruptor.
Guardians of Yogg-Saron are faceless ones that spawns during the Yogg-Saron encounter in Ulduar.
__NOTOC__ Guardian Lashers are orchids that guard the Conservatory of Life inside Ulduar.
Guardians of Zim'Rhuk are drakkari golems that guard Zim'Rhuk in Zul'Drak.

The Guardians of Hyjal are a new faction that appeared in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm, whose job is to protect Mount Hyjal and Nordrassil. They are worshippers of the Ancients, such as Aessina and Tortolla, and wish to repopulate the region with animal life. Much like the Cenarion Circle, they are Neutral and made up mainly of druids.

Gryphon Rider's Boots is purchased from , the Wildhammer clan quartermaster in Thundermar, Twilight Highlands for at Exalted reputation.
The Guardian Cub is a smaller, companion pet version of the Winged Guardian mount.
Guerilla Breastplate is a quest reward from Stopping Kurzen's Legacy.
Guard Untula is a jungle troll found in Zabra'jin in Zangarmarsh watching over a Captured Gnome. She is very abusive to him and will occasionally kick him to make him cry.
Guardian Demons are Terrorguard mobs that act as sentry barriers in Well of Eternity. If they catch you or one of your group members unstealthed, they will quickly wipe you and your group.

Guardian of the Elders is a quilen statue found on the Elders' Path on the Wandering Isle. He tests pandaren to see if they are worthy enough to enter the Wood of Staves. There are many ways to prove one's worth, including besting him in single combat.
__NOTOC__ Gug Fatcandle is a rare kobold found at the entrance to Echo Ridge Mine in Elwynn Forest.
Guard Captain Oakenshield is a pandaren at Stoneplow Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Gu Cloudstrike is the first boss in the Shado-Pan Monastery dungeon.

__NOTOC__ Guardians of the Peak are pandaren guards hired by the grummles to guard their most important settlements, such as the Grummle Bazaar. They are apparently natives to Kun-Lai Summit. They are paid to supplant the Shado-Pan, usual protectors of the grummles, now busy with fighting the mantid and the sha corrupting them.
Guardian Gurtar is an orc quest giver located outside the north entrance to the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale. He is accompanied by two Warsong Guardians.

__NOTOC__ Guardians of the Dawn are pandaren guards found at Dawn's Blossom in the Jade Forest. One is seen training their stance on a rock in a lake below the town. Another appears in the Two Fisted Brew inn in the Grummle Bazaar in Kun-Lai Summit.

__NOTOC__ Guard Shan Long is a pandaren located in Waxwood in the Jade Forest. Before Shan came to Tian Monastery, he was a stranger to battle. During his time as a trainee, he performed adequately but was never placed in any real danger. As a graduate and a wage-earning guard, he was expected to protect his perimeter at all costs. While he could handle Greenwood sprites, the tigers in the western Waxwood were tougher. As such, he asked the adventurer to take care of them for him. When the Burning Legion invaded Tian Monastery, Shan Long relocated to the Shrine of Twin Serpents and with Instructor Myang protected several Injured Tian Pupils.

Channeled by a Priest of the Serpent, Priest of the Hydra, Priest of the Direhorn, and a Priest of the Hawk.
__NOTOC__ Gu'chi the Swarmbringer is a silkworm located in Timeless Isle.
Guardian of Sacrifice is a quilen in the Crypt of Forgotten Kings scenario on heroic only.
__NOTOC__ Gub is a dire troll found in Zul'Gurub. He can be found looking out over the lake on a bridge leading to the temple where Hakkar the Soulflayer is summoned.

__NOTOC__ Guh an ogre that can be found at the Burning Glacier within Frostfire Ridge. Unlike the other ogres in the region, Guh is not hostile but the other to talk to him without incident is to kill the nearby ogres. After talking to them Guh will express dismay at their deaths and wonder who he could trade with now. If you offer to trade with him, Guh will won't believe that is a good idea but offering him to visit your garrison will enable Guh to become a resident of your garrison at the cost of 10 copper.

The Guardian of the Deep is an elite crab boss found in the Forgotten Pool in Blackfathom Deeps. After it chased out Old Serra'kis in order to gain a new lair to spawn its brood, Horde adventurers laid the beast low before the problem could multiply. After the Fourth War, Rexxar and Zekhan entered its lair and confirmed that Ashenvale remains free of the Guardian.

Gug'rokk is an ogre of the Gorian Empire and the final boss in Bloodmaul Slag Mines. He seems to be the leader of the Bloodmaul Slave Traders. Adventurers find him reclining on his throne once they've fought their way through his minions, before engaging him. He is a warlord.
Guide: Disengage is one of the hunter class tomes found in Ashran.
Guide: Soarin' Over Draenor drops from elite NPCs in Ashran and the leaders at the PvP headquarters of Zuldazar and Tiragarde Sound.

The Guardians of the Vault are a faction of orc shaman found at the Vault of the Earth in Tanaan Jungle, where they are guarding :the Cipher of Damnation behind a wall of fire. , who seeks to use the Cipher to sever the link between Draenor and the elements, eventually discovers the location of the cipher and attacks the Vault. In the battle against the forces, most of the shaman are severely injured, and their leader, Lagar the Wise, is killed. Several survivors joined forces with Oronok.

The Guardian of Azeroth is a position held by carefully selected mages, appointed by the . The Guardian exists to protect the realm, and is expected to provide assistance to the when requested; they cannot refuse the king if summoned. The Guardian is charged with staying aloof from others in order to protect them. There is only one Guardian at a time, but Guardian Novitiates are trained in preparation for replacing the current Guardian. There have been several generations of the Guardians. Known Guardians are Quelen and Medivh who trained under Antonidas, one of the Council of Six. The Guardians live in the Tower of Karazhan aided by Moroes and a small community of servants.
